Evaluate the entomological model at a single time point

Source: R/model_impact.R
calculate_impact_timepoint.Rd

Thin wrapper around eval_entomological_model for evaluating the model at one interpolation point given an explicit host-count matrix.

Usage

calculate_impact_timepoint(intervention_obj, model_obj, n_vec, Ni)

Arguments

intervention_obj

Intervention effects object (a single time-point slice: scalars/vectors for alphai, PBi, etc.).

model_obj

Model object from build_model_obj().

n_vec

Number of daily emerging mosquitoes.

Ni

Matrix of host fractions (rows = coverages, cols = host types), consistent with the unit-population convention used by build_model_obj(): protected humans in [0,1], unprotected humans in [0,1] (summing to 1), animals = 1.

Value

List of entomological outputs from eval_entomological_model: Pf_all, or_all, sr_all, sigmai_all, eiri_all, vc_all, f_all, PAmu_all.
